description: A polyphonic Schmitt trigger: each channel's gate turns off when the input falls to the Low voltage and on again when it rises to the Hi voltage

params.text: Sets the voltage at or above which the gate turns on, -10V to 10V
Sets the voltage at or below which the gate turns off, -10V to 10V

inputs.text: The signal the thresholds are applied to; its channel count is what the output carries, so with nothing patched here the output goes quiet
Sets the turn-on voltage by cable in place of the Hi knob, one channel per input channel
Sets the turn-off voltage by cable in place of the Low knob, one channel per input channel

outputs.text: Carries 10V on a channel whose gate is on and 0V on a channel whose gate is off

notes: every channel starts with its gate on, so the output is at 10V until the input first falls to the Low voltage
the Low and Hi knobs both come up at 1V, which makes the module a plain comparator at 1V until they are moved apart

inputs.1:
continuous · polyphonic

unpatched it reads the Hi knob.
inputs.2:
continuous · polyphonic

unpatched it reads the Low knob.
